read-external.title: Read, external provider
read-external.meaning: Reads live data from a market, blockchain or other provider. It changes nothing and can be repeated.

read-local.title: Read, Gina account
read-local.meaning: Reads only state Gina stores for your account. It calls no outside provider and can be repeated.

execute.title: Execute
execute.meaning: Places, changes, cancels or settles an order, trade or fund movement. It acts at once, repeating it can repeat the effect, and it cannot always be undone.

mutate-schedule.title: Change a schedule
mutate-schedule.meaning: Creates or changes a scheduled prompt that Gina runs later. It touches only Gina-held schedule state.

mutate-subscription.title: Change an event subscription
mutate-subscription.meaning: Creates, changes, pauses or resumes a prediction event subscription. It changes only the subscription Gina stores for your account and moves no funds.

delete-subscription.title: Delete an event subscription
delete-subscription.meaning: Deletes a prediction event subscription so it stops delivering. It moves no funds, and it is marked destructive because it cannot be undone.

create-account-subscription.title: Start account observation
create-account-subscription.meaning: Creates a linked-account event subscription and requests collection after wallet and credential checks. It moves no funds and does not grant trading permission.

change-account-subscription.title: Change account observation
change-account-subscription.meaning: Changes a Perps subscription's filters, destination or lifecycle after external wallet and credential checks. It can replace delivery configuration or close an invalid binding, but moves no funds.

account-subscription-lifecycle.title: Account replay and lifecycle
account-subscription-lifecycle.meaning: Reads retained Perps events and updates activity, or permanently ends a subscription. Wallet and credential checks can close an invalid binding. These calls move no funds; replay is nondestructive even though its lifecycle effects require a destructive annotation.

update-destination-label.title: Rename a destination
update-destination-label.meaning: Changes only a destination's label using its current version. It does not change the receiver URL, kind or credential and sends no request.

register-destination.title: Register a webhook destination
register-destination.meaning: Registers a webhook or routine destination shared by Perps and Predictions. Only webhooks can return a generated signing secret once. Routines require their own credentials. It changes only the destination Gina stores for your account and moves no funds. It is marked destructive so your client asks you first, and a secret it passes or returns appears in your client's transcript.

change-destination.title: Change a webhook destination
change-destination.meaning: Renames a destination through Predictions, replaces its signing secret or routine credential, disables it, or deletes a disabled destination with no active or paused attachments. It moves no funds and is marked destructive so your client asks you first. Disabling and deletion cannot be undone. Check both products for attachments before disabling, then list the destination again to get its current version before deletion.

test-destination.title: Test a webhook destination
test-destination.meaning: Sends one optional test event to a registered destination and records the result. It can start a real automation or routine session and use the receiver's quota or paid usage, so it is not a read.

delete-schedule.title: Delete a schedule
delete-schedule.meaning: Deletes or archives a scheduled prompt so it stops running. It touches only Gina-held schedule state, and it is marked destructive because it ends a recurring automation.

sandbox.title: Sandbox
sandbox.meaning: Runs commands in a sandbox that can call every host tool the venue allows, including the execute class, so it carries the strictest class of the tools it can reach.

render.title: Render
render.meaning: Draws a widget from data an earlier read already fetched. It makes no outside call and writes nothing.

render-external.title: Render, may fetch
render-external.meaning: Draws a widget and may fetch the data behind it from an outside provider. It writes nothing.
